title: 第13章阴门第14章护身符
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
不止是师父赵二在观察过往之人。
许峰也一样。
他观察着过往之人，看到他们大多都穿着浅色麻衣，神色木然，并无多少活力。
整个城池，也死气沉沉。
完全没有他往日所见杀头时候，那般的“活泼”，“生动”。
吃过饭，时间也不过是初到下午，可是县城之中还是十分的空乏，师父带着许峰逛街。
趁着此时此刻，许峰展开【地图】，不出所料，许峰看到自己走过的地方，被标记上了名字。
方才他们吃饭的地方，叫做姚家饭庄。
这个饭庄，很像是县城两地的分水岭。
从此间往西和北，房屋零散，应该是穷苦人所居之地，而在另外一边，屋舍建立鳞次，起码有了规整的概念。街面宽严，应当就是富豪之人所居之处。
虽然地图并未曾标注具体名字，可是从这上面的建筑图上，依旧可以以小见大，孔中窥豹，可见一斑。
他们先去了生药铺子，又买了些吃食，沽了一瓶酒，最后又租了一辆鸡公车。
许峰本打算上前套车，孰料上前之后，被师父一把推开。
赵二说道：“我还活着，还轮不到你来推车。”
咯吱咯吱的声音之下，师父就拉着鸡公车出发了！
许峰看到他们朝着城西走了过去，他两只手上，也都提着东西，重要的是他还抱着一瓶酒。
见状，他问道：“师父，咱们这不是回家，这是去哪儿？”
师父不疾不徐的说道：“好不容易进一趟城，吃饱了是要做活计的！
先到你刘叔家里转上一转！取些东西！”
许峰：“好哩，师父，换着来吧。”

师父：“你才吃了几天饱饭，和我争夺？
别吵，跟在我旁边走路，最近就连城里也不太平。
只要有人靠近你，你就大声的斥责，无论男女老幼，特别是面善的，越是面善，越要小心，知道了么？”
许峰：“好，师父！”
许峰自然不会将这话当做耳边风。
好在一路之上，也没遇见麻烦，他们要找的刘叔，就是最初遇见的那位刽子手，亦属于阴门行当，和缝尸匠一样，隶属官方贱业。
但是就算同操贱业，各个行当，依旧上下有别。
譬如衙役，刽子手，都属于贱业，可是他们之身份地位，都在缝尸二皮匠之上。
有些地方，更是有民谚云：“宁愿丧家犬，不为缝尸人”。
等到来到了城外，许峰又看到了那些粗壮的柳树。看着这些柳树，许峰前几日看书看的有些板结的思绪，正经了过来。
看着柳树。
复又回头看了一眼远处绿茵茵的山。
许峰品出来了哪里不对。
树太多了，此处的绿化实在是太过了。
换句话说，柴火的需求量，太少了。
也就意味着，此处的人，太少了！
出了城，肉眼可见，人更少了。
甚至于白天也能听见不知道哪里传出来的狼嚎。
content_en:
Master Zhao Er is not the only one who is observing the people in the past.
The same goes for Xu Feng.
He observed the people passing by and saw that most of them were wearing light-colored linen clothes, with dull expressions and not much vitality.
The entire city was also lifeless.
It was not as "lively" and "vivid" as he had seen in the past when beheadings were carried out.
After dinner, it was only early afternoon, but the county town was still very empty. Master took Xu Feng shopping.
Taking advantage of this moment, Xu Feng unfolded the [Map]. As expected, Xu Feng saw that the places he walked through were marked with names.
The place where they ate just now was called Yao Family Restaurant.
This restaurant is like a watershed between the two parts of the county.
From here to the west and north, the houses are scattered, which should be where poor people live. On the other side, the houses are built in rows, which at least has the concept of order. The streets are wide and strict, so they should be where wealthy people live.
Although the specific name is not marked on the map, from the architectural map above, you can still see the big from the small, and you can see the leopard in the hole.
They first went to the herbal medicine shop, bought some food, bought a bottle of wine, and finally rented a chicken bus.
Xu Feng originally planned to step forward to harness the car, but unexpectedly, after he stepped forward, he was pushed away by his master.
Zhao Er said: "I'm still alive, it's not your turn to push the cart yet."
With a creaking sound, the master pulled the chicken bus and set off!
Xu Feng saw them walking towards the west of the city. He was also holding something in both hands. What was important was that he was also holding a bottle of wine.
Seeing this, he asked: "Master, we are not going home, where are we going?"
The master said calmly: "It's not easy to get into the city. After you eat, you have to do some work!
Let’s go to your Uncle Liu’s house first! Get something! "
Xu Feng: "Okay, Master, let's change."
Master: "You have only had enough food for a few days, and you are fighting with me?
Don't make any noise and walk next to me. Even the city is not peaceful recently.
As long as someone comes near you, you should rebuke them loudly, no matter men, women, old or young, especially those who are kind-hearted. The more kind-hearted you are, the more careful you must be. Do you understand? "
Xu Feng: "Okay, Master!"
Naturally, Xu Feng would not take these words as a deaf ear.
Fortunately, there was no trouble along the way. The Uncle Liu they were looking for was the executioner they met at the beginning. He also belonged to the underworld industry. Like the corpse stitcher, he belonged to the official low-level industry.
But even if they work in a lowly profession, there are still differences between different professions.
For example, government servants and executioners all belong to lowly professions, but their status is higher than that of a cobbler who sews corpses.
In some places, there is even a folk proverb that goes: "I would rather lose my dog ​​than sew the corpse."
When he arrived outside the city, Xu Feng saw those thick willow trees again. Looking at these willow trees, Xu Feng's thoughts, which had been somewhat rigid while reading a few days ago, came to a more serious state.
Looking at the willow tree.
Fu looked back at the green mountains in the distance.
Something is wrong when Xu Fengpin comes out.
There are too many trees and the greenery here is just too much.
In other words, the demand for firewood is too little.
This means that there are too few people here!
After leaving the city, you can see with the naked eye that there are fewer people.
Even during the day, you can hear wolves howling from nowhere.
